_note: Recorded from a real provider call during a live eval run. Replayed when DP_LLM_MODE=recorded so the app runs with no API key.

evidence.notes: Buyer asked to exchange the purchased sweater for a larger size on 2026-10-20, indicating awareness and authorization of the transaction.

input.notes: Buyer’s message requesting an exchange (msg:MSG-2005) demonstrates that they recognized and intended to keep the order, contradicting the claim of an unauthorized transaction (dispute:DEMO-D-2003). The order (order:ORD-2003) was fulfilled and delivered with signature, further supporting that the buyer received the item.
input.rationale: Buyer’s own exchange request shows they authorized the purchase, which is strong evidence against an unauthorized‑transaction claim. PayPal’s guidance advises accepting only when the buyer shows no knowledge of the order. Therefore we recommend fighting the dispute.
